sections.Traits:
Misty Camouflage. The dreg has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in mist or fog that obscures the area.

Bile Spray (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. A creature takes 7 (2d6) acid damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. A failure by at least 5 also adds one level of contamination.

sections.Base stat block: Delerium Dreg, Appendix A, p. 199. Apply the printed Displaced mutation shown in this profile.
sections.Traits:
Misty Camouflage. The dreg has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in mist or fog that obscures the area.
Displacement. Attacks against the dreg have disadvantage. A hit suppresses this trait until the end of its next turn. The trait also stops while the dreg is Incapacitated or its speed is 0.
sections.Actions:
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 20/60-ft. range, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Wielding the spear in two hands for a melee attack deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Teleport (Recharge 4–6). The dreg and its worn or carried equipment teleport up to 60 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space. It can make one melee attack before or after teleporting. A hit deals an extra 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

sections.Base stat block: Delerium Dreg, Appendix A, p. 199. Apply the printed Leeching mutation shown in this profile.
sections.Traits:
Misty Camouflage. The dreg has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in mist or fog that obscures the area.
Bounding Leap. The dreg can long jump up to 30 ft. or high jump up to 15 ft. with or without a running start.
sections.Actions:
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 20/60-ft. range, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. Wielding the spear in two hands for a melee attack deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Blood Drain. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one creature. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the dreg attaches to the target. While attached, the dreg cannot attack and the target takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage at the start of each of the dreg's turns. The dreg travels with the target without spending movement. It can spend 5 ft. of movement on its turn to let go. The target or another creature can use an action to pull it off.
